summary: Iteration 7 — RETEST of BDESIGNER Requirement Form auth flows after main-agent fixes. All 4 target flows PASS end-to-end at 1440x900 desktop. Flow B: /?auth=register direct AuthModal signup now correctly navigates to /client and shows client-empty-state (previous HIGH bug FIXED — redirectAfterAuth now called from handleRegister; verified with new email bdtest+iter7B_1790500301@example.com). Flow A (anonymous full requirement -> step 8 registration): completed all 7 steps (architectural service, dims 30/30/40/40 -> G+0, Banashankari address, construction=No, defaults, summary), submitted step-8 registration with bdtest+iter7A_1790500399@example.com, saw toast 'Account created — your project requirement is saved', landed on /client with data-testid=client-projects populated (1 project). Password mismatch inline (data-testid=req-password-mismatch) confirmed when passwords differ, both eye toggles (req-reg-password-toggle / req-reg-confirm-password-toggle) flip input type password<->text correctly. Flow F (existing email at step 8): re-ran anonymous flow to step 8 with the same Flow A email + a password; UI shows data-testid=req-email-exists ('An account already exists with this email.') + data-testid=req-login-to-continue. Clicking req-login-to-continue opened the AuthModal on top of the requirement form WITHOUT navigating away (URL stayed on '/'). Logging in with the existing credentials did NOT hard-redirect — the requirement form's resume useEffect ran, saved the lead, and navigated to /client where the same account's project count went from 1 to 2 (draft preserved, no data re-entry). Flow E (logged-in, no reg step): step counter reads 'Step 1 of 6' (vs 'Step 1 of 7' anonymous), no data-testid=req-registration nodes rendered, summary CTA text is 'Create This Project'; clicking it saved the project with toast 'Your project has been saved' and landed on /client (project count 3).

issues: Header shows 'Step 7 of 6' at the Project Summary step for logged-in users. STEP_META hardcodes n=7 for the summary, but STEPS.length=6 for logged-in users, so the displayed step number exceeds the total. Cosmetic — flow still works. Fix: derive n from STEPS.indexOf(step)+1 instead of the hardcoded meta.n.

React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' on /client when 2+ 'Untitled Project' cards render. ClientHome.jsx likely uses project.name (or missing id) as list key. Fix: use project.id as the React key.

action_items: COSMETIC: RequirementForm — use STEPS.indexOf(step)+1 for the displayed step number so logged-in summary reads 'Step 6 of 6' instead of 'Step 7 of 6'.
MINOR: ClientHome.jsx — use unique project.id as React key in the client-projects list to eliminate the duplicate-key React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthModal handleRegister redirect fix is correct: it now calls redirectAfterAuth(data) after handleClose(false); redirectAfterAuth honors bd_suppress_auth_redirect (Flow D/F) and falls back to '/client' when data.role is missing, so both direct-register (Flow B) and post-register requirement submit (Flow A which uses navigate('/client') inside RequirementForm.handleRegister) both land on /client.

RequirementForm login-to-continue flow (Flow F) correctly sets sessionStorage bd_suppress_auth_redirect=1 before opening the login modal, so AuthModal.handleLogin -> redirectAfterAuth early-returns without navigating; the RequirementForm useEffect then submits the lead using the resumed authenticated session — draft in localStorage LS_KEY is preserved end-to-end.

STEP_META numbering: STEP_META keys are hardcoded (7=Summary) — when the elevation step is skipped AND the registration step is skipped (Flow E), STEPS = [1,2,3,4,5,7], length=6, but rendered header reads 'Step 7 of 6' at the summary. Non-functional but confusing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 required flows are now working end-to-end. The two remaining nits are cosmetic (step counter 'of 6' vs 'of 7' is correct, but header n reads 7 at the logged-in summary) and a React duplicate-key warning on ClientHome. Neither blocks the auth-flow retest goal. Helpful selectors: (1) req-next appears TWICE (mobile hidden + desktop sidebar visible) — always iterate and click the visible one. (2) req-create-account also appears twice — same rule. (3) Location picker: click req-change-location, then iterate [data-testid^='req-area-'] and skip 'req-area-other'. (4) req-reg-password / req-reg-confirm-password ARE the input elements (PasswordInput exposes testid on the input), so .fill() works directly. (5) To force-logout in Playwright: click [data-testid=nav-profile-btn] then [data-testid=menu-logout], or clear cookies + localStorage + reload. (6) Login modal inputs are input[data-testid=auth-email-input] and input[data-testid=auth-password-input], submit is auth-submit-btn.
rca of the issue: Previous HIGH bug (Flow B: register did not navigate to /client) is RESOLVED. RCA of the fix: AuthModal.handleRegister now calls redirectAfterAuth(data) explicitly AFTER handleClose(false); this bypasses the previous reliance on the authOpen && user && user.id effect (which the modal-close would race). Flow F draft-preservation works because sessionStorage.setItem('bd_suppress_auth_redirect','1') is set before opening the login modal, so AuthModal.redirectAfterAuth early-returns; RequirementForm's resume useEffect then completes the submit + navigates to /client. Flow E works because STEPS excludes step 8 when user.id exists, and the summary CTA calls handleProjectSubmit which does its own navigate('/client').
